'''Onna Beskren''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. She made her living as a [[Stimulant/Legends|stimulant]] vendor on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].

==Behind the scenes==
Onna first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as a stimulant vendor on Tatooine. The ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide]]'' provided a surname for Onna, but misspelled her first name as "Ona."
